insight: Founded 2023 by MIT alumni; a16z led a $75M Series B in Oct 2025, lifting total funding to $108M, with over a billion pages parsed.
name: Reducto
tagline: Agentic document parsing and extraction for AI teams, via one API.
description: A document-intelligence API that parses, splits, extracts, and edits PDFs, images, spreadsheets, and slides into clean, structured output for RAG and AI pipelines. It blends custom in-house models with frontier ones and bills via usage credits, automatically discounting pages it can parse without the heavier pipeline.

changelog.summary: Funding updated — a16z led a $75M Series B (Oct 2025), bringing total funding to $108M (was a $24.5M Series A led by Benchmark).

edge: Tuned for governed, regulated-industry extraction — claims higher accuracy on complex layouts than LlamaParse.
pros: Single API: parse, split, extract, edit

references.title: Best PDF Parsers for AI and RAG Workflows in 2026
